info.title: Wacki
info.author: szczuru
info.details:
A faithful, cross-platform port of Wacki: Kosmiczna rozgrywka (1998) — a Polish point-and-click adventure — reconstructed from the decompiled WACKI.EXE.
Decompilation was done by mszula (https://github.com/mszula/wacki), ported using Claude by szczuru.

AI use: AI-generated, not reviewed line by line.
